title: A 76-year-old man with a rapidly enlarging, erythematous gingival lesion
html: A 76-year-old man was admitted to the Third Affiliated Hospital of the Fourth Military Medical University, Xi’an, China, with a 20-day history of a rapidly enlarging erythematous gingival lesion in the anterior mandible. He denied oral pain, numbness, swelling, or spontaneous bleeding. One year earlier, he had been diagnosed with kidney cell carcinoma with metastasis to the L4 vertebra and was treated with programmed cell death protein 1 inhibitors. Surveillance imaging performed 4 months prior showed enlarging pulmonary nodules, raising concern for disease progression with lung metastases.
